about: QT-26 B museum case: VWRL.L's Fri 23 Oct 2026 daily bar, sane when stored, broken on a re-fetch. Fri 23 Oct 17:10:32 UTC (after London's 15:30 UTC close) the top-up stored a sane 23 Oct row. Mon 26 Oct 06:17:30 UTC the whole-history re-fetch brought it back with NO close; the door set the broken bar aside and rewrote the file whole, so the sane row was lost and the advisor could not process Friday (QT-25). Mon 26 Oct 20:11:06 UTC the re-fetch came back sane, and the quarantine file was rewritten whole too, so the broken bar vanished from it (335 rows -> 334). Friday's own stored figures were overwritten on Monday and are known only as sane; 'sane' below is the row as the store holds it since Mon 20:11 UTC. The broken bar's figures are QT-25's record of it (docs/reports/QT-25.md, A5), the only copy left. 'historic_broken': one of the 334 older broken bars (its close below its low) the provider sends on every fetch, as in the store's quarantine. Columns: open, high, low, close, volume; prices in pounds; dates on London's clock.
